name: I want 2 be single
source:
Deja Sparrow is a new student starting fresh at a new school. Everything was going smoothly…but then she finds 3 love letters in her locker by 3 different boys who really have a thing for her. The problem is…Deja doesn’t want a boyfriend. Deja wants to be single. Why can’t they just leave her alone?

[From [url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=20403]Lemma Soft Forums[/url]]
translation:
德雅·斯帕罗 (Deja Sparrow) 是一名新学生，在新学校开始新生活。一切都很顺利……但随后她在储物柜里发现了3个真正喜欢她的男孩写的3封情书。问题是……德雅不想要男朋友。德雅想单身。为什么他们不能让她一个人呆着呢？

[来自[url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=20403]引理软论坛[/url]]
